For the default local provider, `LocalStorageProvider.upload_file` reads the bytes and writes them to `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)` (`storage/provider.py:60-67`), where `UPLOAD_DIR = DATA_DIR / 'uploads'` (`config.py:168`) — so the bytes land at `<DATA_DIR>/uploads/<uuid4>_<original_filename>`, a flat directory with no per-user or hashed subfolder.
